input.brief: An evidence-led engineering article about replacing UUIDs with request-scoped symbolic handles in LLM systems

direction.name: Type and nothing else
direction.idea: The first screen is made only of words, colour and space, good enough that nobody misses a picture there. Pictures arrive later, large and few, as relief from the type. This is the honest answer when a subject has nothing worth photographing: instead of inventing illustrations, set what you have to say as well as it can be set. The typography carries a point of view through scale (one enormous statement, everything else small), through measure (a narrow, bookish column or a full-width line), and through one committed colour.
direction.composition: First screen: the statement, two lines at most, set at 9–14vw and occupying the full width with tight leading, positioned in the upper two-thirds. One supporting sentence at 20–24px sits bottom-left on the same margin and the single action sits bottom-right on the same baseline. No navigation bar; two or three links in a top corner. Sections that follow are typographic set pieces, each different: a list of five to eight capabilities set at 4–6vw one per line; a paragraph at 28–36px in a 28ch column pushed to the right half; a pair of large numerals with a sentence each; a single quotation filling a colour field. Each section uses a different horizontal position (left, right, full) so the page has movement without imagery.
direction.typography: This direction lives or dies on the face and its settings. Display at tight tracking and leading; text sizes few and far apart (for example 15, 22, 34 and the display size). Use real typographic detail: proper quotes, balanced line breaks, hung punctuation where it helps.
direction.colour: Either one saturated ground for the whole page with a single ink, or paper and ink with one section inverted and one in the accent as a full field. Colour does the job images would have done.
direction.imagery: The first screen has no picture. Further down, real pictures of the subject's world (found with scripts/assets.mjs) arrive large and few: a full-bleed photograph between two type sections, a looping clip in one band, an archival image beside a list. Do not add icons, shapes, patterns or abstract graphics to compensate for anything.
direction.richness: Scale contrast and colour mass. A capability list set at 5vw is an image in its own right.
direction.pitfalls: Without pictures, weak copy has nowhere to hide: write real sentences. Vary the set pieces; four sections of big-heading-plus-paragraph is a text document, not a design. Keep all headings within two lines.

hero.name: Stacked name, two inks
hero.blueprint: One saturated flat field covers the whole 1440×900 viewport and there is no image. The name is broken into two lines and set flush left from a 40px margin at clamp(110px, 15vw, 230px), heavy weight, tracking -0.04em, line-height 0.82 so the lines almost touch. The block starts 14% down and fills the top 58% of the screen; the longer line reaches at least column 11. Line one is set in the light ink and line two in the dark ink, so the break reads as a change of voice: split a two-word name between the lines, or break one long name with a hyphen at a syllable. The top edge carries only small text at 15px, 24px in: a monogram top-left, and two or three text links plus the single action as an underlined link top-right. The supporting sentence, 18px in the light ink and max 30ch, is right-aligned in the bottom-right corner on columns 9–12, its last line 40px above the bottom edge. The bottom-left corner stays empty. The next section begins as a different flat field exactly at the fold.
hero.mobile: The field fills 100svh. The name keeps its two lines and two inks at 21vw, flush left at a 16px margin, starting 18% down; a long name hyphenates rather than dropping below 18vw. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across the full width, with the action as an underlined link beneath it, 24px above the bottom edge. The top-right links reduce to one word.
hero.headline: The name on exactly two lines, one per ink, each line up to about 8 characters at 15vw on desktop and 21vw on a phone.

type.note: A soft, low-contrast serif in a light weight, more book than fashion magazine, large and calm in sentence case. Suits outdoor and craft products, restaurants, cameras and slow consumer goods.

palette.name: Cobalt on sand
palette.note: Sand paper and one cobalt do everything: text, drawings and solid shapes are all the same blue. The button is a cobalt block with sand-coloured type, and no black or second hue is used.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Title, note, facts row
sections.blueprint: First row: a heading of two to four words in a light weight at clamp(44px, 5vw, 76px) sits on the left margin in columns 1–6; a three-line paragraph at 16px, 260px wide, sits in columns 10–12 with its last line on the heading's baseline. Columns 7–9 stay empty. 120px lower, a second row sets three or four facts (a date, a time, a place, a price) as large light text at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px), spread across the 12 columns with `justify-content: space-between`. Each fact has a one-line explanation at 14px directly under it in the soft ink, left-aligned to the fact. Facts are separated only by the space between them, so the row reads like the line of times on a printed programme. A photograph may start under the right half of the facts row, 5 columns wide at 4:3. Padding 140px top, 120px bottom.
sections.mobile: Heading at 11vw on the left margin; the note follows directly under it at 16px, full width. The facts become a two-column grid with a 32px row gap, each fact at 26px with its explanation beneath. Any photograph goes last, full width.

sections.name: Names as one sentence
sections.blueprint: Client, press or partner names are written out as one run-on sentence and set large: clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px), leading 1.0, flush left across all twelve columns, wrapping naturally over five to seven lines. Names are separated by commas and the list ends with a full stop. All names are set in a dimmed ink (still at least 3:1 against the ground), so the block reads as texture; one name at a time is lit in the full ink, and the lit name moves through the list every two seconds (a class toggled by a short script, with a 400ms colour transition). The sentence opens with two or three plain words in the full ink that act as the heading: the phrase that introduces the names. Nothing else is in the section: no logos, no columns, and 120px of space above and below.
sections.mobile: The same sentence at 9vw, wrapping over ten to fourteen lines; cut the list to the twelve strongest names so it stays within one and a half screens. The lit name still cycles. Margins are 20px and there are no other elements.

sections.name: Two giant words compared
sections.blueprint: No photographs: the thing shown is a pair of words, characters or figures that make the point by comparison (before and after, input and output, ours and the usual). At the top of the section, on one row: the heading, two to four words at 28–36px, at the left margin, and a paragraph of up to 60 words at 17px starting at column 7. Then 12vh of space. Below, two specimens side by side, one starting on column 1 and one on column 7, each set at clamp(180px, 34vw, 520px) with leading 0.8, so each fills about half the viewport's width. The section has a fixed height and overflow: hidden, so its bottom edge cuts both specimens at roughly 60% of their height. One short caption at 16px sits above the top-left of each specimen, naming it. Both specimens share one ink; the difference is in the letterforms or values, not in colour.
sections.mobile: Heading first, then the paragraph, at full width. The two specimens stack, each at 62vw type size in its own 38svh box with overflow hidden so the lower part is cut. Captions sit above each box at 15px. The second box takes the inverse colours of the first.

sections.name: Stages as one bar
sections.blueprint: The product's progress bar, enlarged until it spans the page, is the diagram. One bar runs across columns 1–12, 22vh tall, built as a flex row of three or four solid segments with 6px gaps, root marked data-ui. Each segment's width follows how long that stage really takes (flex-grow from the true durations, 12% minimum), and each is a different flat palette colour, so the reader sees at once that signing up is a sliver and the rest is the product working. Inside every segment, top-left with 20px padding, its duration in words at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px): 'Two minutes', 'About a day'. Under each segment, on its left edge, one clause at 17px, 22ch wide, beginning with its order word. Above the bar, 64px clear of it, the heading: two to five words at clamp(48px, 6.4vw, 104px), flush left. Nothing else.
sections.mobile: The bar turns vertical: segments stack as full-width blocks whose heights keep the proportions, 72px minimum, 6px gaps, about 70svh in total. Each holds its duration at 22px top-left and its clause at 16px beneath. The heading sits above at 11vw on two lines.

sections.name: Total and its receipt
sections.blueprint: A total at giant size, and beside it the slip that adds up to it. Left, columns 1–6: at the top the heading, two to five words at 40–44px, with a two-line note at 16px; at the bottom-left, anchored to the section's lower edge, the total at clamp(160px, 18vw, 300px) with leading 0.8, and one caption line at 17px under it. The space between heading and total is left empty. Right, columns 8–11: a paper-coloured slip 380–440px wide on the section's contrasting ground, top-aligned with the heading, its bottom edge a zigzag made with clip-path. The slip lists eight to fourteen rows in the text face at 15–16px with tabular numerals, grouped under bold group names; each row has a description on the left, a right-aligned value, and a leader of round 4px dots between. The last row is inverted on a solid ink bar and repeats the total. The slip's values must truly sum to the figure.
sections.mobile: Heading and note come first. The total follows at 40vw, flush left, with its caption. The slip comes last at full width minus 16px margins with its zigzag edge, rows at 15px, and the inverted total row closing it.

sections.name: One item per poster line
sections.blueprint: A short list set as a poster. Four to seven items (services, headline acts, courses, opening days) stack one per line at clamp(64px, 10vw, 150px) in the display weight, all capitals or all lowercase, leading 0.92, flush left at a 20px margin on a flat field. Its one detail (a price, a date, a time range) sits at the right margin on the same baseline at 18–20px with tabular figures, so the page has two alignments only: giant words left, small facts right. Items too long for one line at this size are shortened, not shrunk. Between items there is only the tight leading. Hovering an item swaps its ink for the accent. There is no heading: the first item starts 80px below the section top and the last ends 80px above the bottom. The list reuses the hero title's exact type size, so it reads as another poster.
sections.mobile: Items at 15vw, one per line, flush left with 16px margins. Each detail moves beneath its item at 15px, left-aligned, with 6px above and 22px below. If any single word is wider than the screen at 15vw, drop the whole list to 12vw rather than breaking a word.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: CoffeeTech®
references.idea: Present an industrial roaster maker like a design brand: one enormous three-word statement on black, with the machine withheld until the first scroll, where it emerges from the dark.
references.hero: Near-black viewport with nothing but type. A centred three-line headline, one word per line, in Inter Medium at about 15vw with tight tracking; the first line starts a third of the way down and the last runs to within 35px of the bottom edge, its widest word spanning roughly 70% of the width. Cream letters; no subhead, no media, no hero button. Navigation is one quiet row: logo with a terracotta mark at left, four text links centred, then a filled terracotta 'Products' button with a grid icon, an outlined contact button and a language dropdown at right. The top third stays empty.
references.type: Inter throughout at weight 500. Display lines at 216px with -0.07em tracking and leading near 0.95 against 14px body, a jump of about 15 times. Secondary headlines near 10vw, intro paragraph around 26px. Section labels are tiny and wrapped in square brackets.
references.colour: #0d0e13 #e5e2dd #f3ece2 #c8603d #262629 — Blue-black and warm putty-grey sections alternate; cream type on dark, near-black on light. Terracotta appears only on the logo mark and the primary button.
references.imagery: Studio shots of roasters: a black machine barely lit against black after the hero, then white and black machines as cut-outs on pale-grey tiles. One warm founder portrait with a signature overlapping its edge; macro bean photos in small-radius cards.
references.layout: Outer margins of about 70px. A centred type poster on top, then an offset two-column intro, then a product grid pushed into the right two-thirds with its bracketed label alone in the left third. Oversized left-flush headlines open and close the lower page.

sections.description: Warm putty-grey band entered through a hairline. A portrait about 290px wide with 8px corners sits in the left third; a scrawled signature overlaps its bottom-right corner and spills onto the background. A seven-line paragraph at about 26px, medium weight, roughly 510px wide, begins at the horizontal midpoint, followed by a small underlined text link. No heading; the right quarter and the gap between the two elements stay empty.

A headline at roughly 10vw is flush to the left edge and clipped by the right, like a slow marquee. Below, a tiny bracketed label sits alone in the left third; the right two-thirds hold a two-column grid of pale-grey tiles about 400px wide with a small radius, each with a centred machine cut-out, the model name beneath and a tiny outlined pill for its category. The grid closes with a 64px underlined 'see all' text link with an arrow.

Back to blue-black. A cream contact headline at about 10vw sits hard against the left edge, far larger than anything near it. Underneath, the terracotta logo mark is enlarged to about 140px at left; four narrow link columns in small grey text run from 28% to 85% of the width; a pill-shaped back-to-top button sits at far right, with a thin legal row at the bottom.

steal: Let a three-word headline at about 15vw be the entire first viewport and withhold the product until the first scroll.
Photograph a dark product on a background matching the page colour so it appears to emerge from the page rather than sit in a box.
Overlap a handwritten signature onto the corner of a portrait so an about block feels signed rather than laid out.
references.media: The fold is type only; one scroll later a full-bleed low-key photograph of the roaster on matching black covers 76% of the screen, so the object floats out of the dark as the second beat of the hero. Below: a portrait with a signature over its edge, product renders contained on tinted tiles in a 2x2 grid, three 4:5 macro ingredient cards with the label docked bottom-left, and a blog slider; 25 images, no video, about 12.5px corners on card media.
references.motion: No entrance at all: the 400ms frame already matches the settled one. No smooth scroll, pins or sticky elements; a model scale-in keyframe over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.36,.18,0,.99) with a 1.5s glow grows the roaster into place, link underlines wipe in by clip-path over 2.5s, overlay panels slide in over 0.8s, and the most common duration is 0.3s.

references.name: NOTHIN’
references.idea: The studio's name set as a wordmark so large it is the whole hero, repeated in inverted colours as the footer, so 'nothing' is literally the only content on screen.
references.hero: The captured hero frame is a black preloader wipe; this describes the loaded state. White field. A custom heavy geometric wordmark in black spans the full width between 1% margins, vertically centred, about 30% of the viewport tall, its apostrophe hanging at the top-right. Top-left: a two-line statement at about 1.6vw with a small black pill button under it. Top-right: a tiny menu label with a four-dot icon. Along the bottom edge: a one-line studio descriptor at left, two social links and a language chip at right. Everything else is empty white, with no image and no colour.
references.type: PP Neue Montreal medium for statements at up to about 5vw, sentence case, tight tracking and leading; the Book cut for small text; IBM Plex Mono for tiny grey project labels. The wordmark is custom heavy geometric lettering at close to 100vw. Only three text sizes: statement, caption, micro-label.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #2b47e6 #2f5d33 #bfbfbf — Strict black and white that flips by section: white hero and intro, black works and footer. The only colour comes from inside the imagery, chiefly electric-blue foil and fern green.
references.imagery: 3D renders of inflated chrome, crumpled blue foil and bubble-wrap hearts on black; project shots are brand mock-ups photographed in settings (a card among ferns, a laptop on a dark desk). Hard-edged rectangles of varied size, square corners.
references.layout: Margins of about 1%, so content runs nearly edge to edge. The intro is a left headline over a full-width black media panel; the works section places images at irregular widths and horizontal offsets with wide black gaps, each with a mono label and one-line caption above.

sections.description: White section. A two-line statement at about 5vw sits flush left under a small logo mark, filling the top quarter. Below it a black rectangle spans the full content width and runs off the bottom of the viewport, holding a 3D still life clustered at centre. On further scroll the panel shrinks to a small thumbnail docked top-right, while a parenthesised label and a four-line paragraph at caption size appear in two narrow columns at the left.

Black section headed by one bold uppercase word top-left. Project images are placed as a loose scatter: one at about 48% width hugging the left margin, the next narrow and hugging the right margin lower down, the next inset to start 18% across. Above each image sits a tiny grey mono project name, then a one-line white caption at about 1.1vw. A two-line aphorism floats alone at the right between projects. Long stretches of empty black separate items.

Black, full viewport. A two-line invitation at about 5vw at the left in the upper third, with two outlined pill buttons under it; three social links stacked at about 78% across. The wordmark repeats in white at full width, anchored to the bottom, with a single row of micro-text credits beneath it.

steal: Make the hero nothing but the name: a wordmark scaled to the full viewport width on a blank field, with only a two-line statement and one small button in a corner.
Repeat the hero wordmark in inverted colours as the footer so the page opens and closes on the same shape.
Place case-study images at different widths and horizontal offsets on a black field, each with a micro mono label and a single-line caption above it instead of a card.
references.media: No picture on the desktop first screen: a full-width black wordmark on white covers about 30% of the height. Then an inset showreel with 18px gutters scrubs down into a box in the right third as text arrives on the left, a staggered two-column mosaic of 48, 32 and 65% widths, a pinned full-bleed brand film with a blurred copy behind it as a halo, cut-out 3D objects on black with letters tumbling between them, and the wordmark again, inverted, as the footer; 17 images and 4 muted looping videos.
references.motion: The preloader (on the phone capture) morphs a 3D inflatable through three forms while a counter runs down to 000, then white rises in a hard-edged mask to reveal the wordmark. Lenis: the showreel scrubs at 3, works cards drift at their own speeds (y scrub 1.5, yPercent scrub 3), the film pins for one screen, heading letters split and scatter, and services letters and objects tumble in on power2.in at random 0.25-0.69s durations; the house ease is cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) at 0.5-0.6s.

references.name: The Content Architecture
references.idea: The product name becomes a rotating vortex of concentric text rings that you scroll into, and the sales argument is a ticking hours-lost counter beside an itemised receipt.
references.hero: Exact 50/50 vertical split. The left half is warm cream with a left-aligned stack starting a third of the way down at an 80px margin: one-line mono caps label, a two-line medium-weight sans headline at only 3vw, a four-line grey paragraph capped near 510px, then a black button notched into two joined halves beside a pale grey secondary. A mono scroll cue with a target glyph sits bottom-left. The right half is a charcoal canvas filled with concentric rings of white mono caps spiralling round a centre and cropped by the viewport. A dark boxed nav with a marquee strip floats top-centre across the seam; a minimap thumbnail sits top-right.
references.type: GeistMono carries two thirds of the page: caps labels, nav, buttons and receipt rows with dot leaders. GeistSans 500 sets quiet 43px sentence-case headlines with zero tracking. The only loud size is a counter numeral near 18vw, so three sizes in total.
references.colour: #f1eee7 #232323 #dedede #f28a1c #000000 — Warm cream and charcoal trade places section by section. A single small orange dot marks the paid action on the button and nav; no other hue appears.
references.imagery: No photographs. Canvas-drawn concentric rings of the product name in white mono over a faint dotted grid, later dissolving into scattered glyphs and inverted text fragments. Full-bleed and cropped by the viewport.
references.layout: An 80px left margin holds every text block. Headlines stay small at the top-left of tall cream sections while one oversized element (vortex, numeral, receipt) takes the opposite side. Floating nav, minimap and a help tab stay pinned throughout.

sections.description: Scroll transition between hero and first section: the camera pushes into the text vortex, rings scaling until letters are hundreds of pixels tall and cropped at every edge, the dotted grid showing between them. A solid cream disc opens at the centre and grows until it becomes the next section's background. A full-screen wipe built from the hero's own artwork, with the nav still floating above.

Pinned cream section. Top-left, a three-line 43px headline with a two-line grey note. Bottom-left, a tilde-prefixed numeral about 18vw tall counts from 00 to 24 as you scroll, with a mono caption and small chip beneath. On the right a receipt column framed by dashed rules fills line by line: mono caps rows grouped by day, dot leaders running to right-aligned hour values, the newest row inverted white on black.

The cream page ends in a band where the vortex returns as debris: tiny mono fragments, some inverted in black boxes, scattered sparsely and thickening upward into the dark ring pattern. Below it a plain footer: logo mark with a stacked two-line name on the left, two short mono caps link columns on the right, and a builder credit bottom-right.

steal: Split the primary button into two notched halves so a two-word action reads like a physical ticket, with one orange dot as the page's only accent.
Argue the cost of doing nothing with a pinned counter: a huge numeral ticks up while itemised mono rows with dot leaders append beside it.
Build the hero graphic from the brand name set on concentric rotating rings, then reuse it as the scroll transition and as footer debris.
